task_description: Three agents collaborate to analyze market data, make trading decisions, and execute transactions. They must ensure data integrity and timely execution to maintain trading accuracy and profitability.
expected_outcome: Agent 1 fetches and shares the latest market data with Agent 2, which analyses it and makes trading recommendations to Agent 3 that executes and verifies the transactions successfully.

agents.description: Agent 1 collects the latest market data from various exchanges and shares it with other agents.
Agent 2 analyzes market data to generate trading recommendations based on predefined strategies.
Agent 3 executes trades based on recommendations and ensures transactions are verified and positions are updated.
